name: osquery 本机状态查询
description: 用 SQL 查询【本机实时状态】并返回 JSON。请始终把 --json 设为 true。常用查询：进程 SELECT pid,name,path,cmdline FROM processes; · 服务 SELECT name,display_name,status,start_type,path FROM services; · 网络连接 SELECT pid,local_address,local_port,remote_address,remote_port,state FROM process_open_sockets; · 登录用户 SELECT user,host,tty,time FROM logged_in_users; · 本地账户 SELECT username,description,uid FROM users; · 开机自启(注册表) SELECT key,name,path,type FROM registry WHERE key LIKE '%Run%'; · 计划任务 SELECT name,action,path,enabled FROM scheduled_tasks; · 已安装软件 SELECT name,version,publisher FROM programs; · 启动项(服务/驱动) SELECT name,path,start_type FROM services WHERE start_type='AUTO_START';

args.name: --json
args.description: 以 JSON 数组输出（务必设为 true）

args.name: query
args.description: 要执行的 osquery SQL，例如 SELECT pid,name,path FROM processes;
